title: Sibling test-run persistence fences still use real-time deadlines (compaction, cards, registration)
outcome: The test-run compaction, card and registration persistence fences measure their deadlines on the state's existing Engram budget clock, as the observation fences do after w-4f55, so a hand-driven fixture that polls them cannot be expired by elapsed host time. Production stays on real time with unchanged deadlines.
acceptance: Sibling test-run persistence fences still use real-time deadlines (compaction, cards, registration) is done
